items.definition:
the male external sexual organ
The doctor explained the anatomy of the penis.

a plant used for drugs or fiber
Some countries have legalized cannabis for medical use.

the intrinsic nature or indispensable quality of something
The essence of his argument was that everyone deserves respect.

extravagant or intensive publicity or promotion
There was a lot of hype around the new movie, but it wasn't that good.

a feeling or opinion
Public sentiment was against the new policy.

doorway or point of beginning
She stood on the threshold of a new career.

decision of a jury or judgment
The jury delivered a guilty verdict.

the state of being worthy of respect
She faced the challenge with great dignity.

a person's sense of self-esteem or self-importance
His large ego made him difficult to work with.

the process of joining two or more things together
The restaurant serves a delicious fusion of Asian and European cuisine.

a system of ideas and ideals
Political ideology often shapes public policy.

the action or state of including or being included
The school promotes the inclusion of all students.

a statement or idea on which a conclusion or theory is based
The argument was based on a false premise.

aggressive pressure or intimidation
The company has a strict policy against harassment.

a completely empty space; a feeling of emptiness
He felt a void in his life after she left.

the action of making new or secret information known
The company made a full disclosure of its financial records.

the great size or extent of something; the importance, quality, or significance of something
The earthquake was of great magnitude.

a limit or boundary that defines the scope of a particular process or activity
We need to define the parameters of the project.

a chemical element, used in electronics
Silicon is a key material in computer chips.

a thing that prompts or encourages someone
The prize money was a spur to greater effort.

a person or organization officially attached to a larger body
The local club became an affiliate of the national organization.

protection granted by a state to someone who has left their home country as a political refugee
Many people seek asylum in other countries due to conflict.

an achievement that requires great courage, skill, or strength
Climbing Mount Everest is an incredible feat.

restoration to health/normal life
He is undergoing rehabilitation after his injury.

a quantity having direction as well as magnitude
In physics, force is a vector quantity.

an addictive drug
The police seized a large amount of cocaine.

a person, company, or institution sued or accused in a court of law
The defendant pleaded not guilty to the charges.

a belief or set of beliefs held and taught by a Church, political party, or other group
The new economic doctrine was widely debated.

a direct vote by the electorate on a particular proposal
The country held a referendum on joining the union.

a developmental disorder
Autism affects how a person communicates and interacts.

an economic and political system
Capitalism is characterized by private ownership.

an arrangement of parts or elements
Check the network configuration settings.

an official order or commission to do something
The new policy has a clear mandate from the voters.

sexual orientation or activity
Discussions about human sexuality are becoming more open.

a series of things following one another
There has been a succession of bad weather days.

large guns used in warfare
The army used heavy artillery in the battle.

a title given to a woman equivalent to a knight
Dame Judi Dench is a renowned actress.

soldiers who fight on foot
The infantry advanced slowly across the field.

a solemn promise, often invoking a divine witness, regarding one's future action or behavior
He took an oath to tell the truth in court.

a person who vigorously supports their country and is prepared to defend it against enemies or detractors
He was a true patriot, always putting his country first.

the act of rebuilding
The city began the reconstruction after the earthquake.

a surprising disclosure
The discovery was a revelation to the scientific community.

a person or thing that announces or signals the approach of something
The robin is a herald of spring.

the art of effective speaking or writing
His speech was full of powerful rhetoric.

preservation from harm or ruin; deliverance from sin
Many seek salvation through faith.

a whole formed by combining several separate elements
The aggregate of all sales figures showed a decline.

a material made from two or more different materials
The aircraft wing was made of a strong composite material.

behavior showing high moral standards
Patience is a great virtue.

the process of taking legal action
The company is involved in ongoing litigation over patent infringement.

a permanent unit of an army
The regiment marched in formation.

a place of refuge or safety
The church offered sanctuary to the refugees.

a military operation in which enemy forces surround a town or building
The city was under siege for months.

the period for which an office or position is held
She was granted tenure at the university.

a particular sector of a population
The company is targeting a younger demographic.

a highly addictive analgesic drug
Heroin is a dangerous illegal drug.

difference in size, degree, circumstances, etc.; lack of equality
There is growing income inequality in many countries.

an author's text before publication
The author submitted the final manuscript to the publisher.

a star showing a sudden large increase in brightness
Astronomers observed a new nova in the distant galaxy.

a company controlled by a larger company
The smaller company became a subsidiary of the multinational corporation.

the study of religious faith and practice
She decided to pursue a degree in theology.

the deliberate killing of a large group of people
The international community condemned the act of genocide.

the quality of behaving or speaking in such a way as to avoid causing offense or revealing private information
He handled the sensitive matter with great discretion.

the state of being subject to death; the death rate
The mortality rate for this disease is very low.

a person or thing of colossal size, strength, or influence
He was a titan of industry.
